name: MYLLYMATTI
description: Myllymatti is a Finnish card game that is the ancestor of the Swedish game Skitgubbe and the Norwegian game Mattis. It is a two-phase game: first players collect cards by winning tricks, then they try to get rid of those cards by beating opponents' cards. The last player holding cards loses.

content.text: Myllymatti is a Finnish card game that is the ancestor of the Swedish game Skitgubbe and the Norwegian game Mattis. It is a two-phase game: first players collect cards by winning tricks, then they try to get rid of those cards by beating opponents' cards. The last player holding cards loses.
Myllymatti originated in Finland and is mentioned in several 19th century newspaper articles. It is the direct ancestor of Swedish Skitgubbe (also known as Mas or Mjolnarmatte) and Norwegian Mattis.
Standard 52-card deck. Ranking: A (high), K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 (low).
All cards dealt evenly - 17 cards to each player, with one card set aside or dealer takes the extra.

items.text: Skitgubbe (Swedish): Swedish variant with optional rules for compulsory ties.
Mattis (Norwegian): Norwegian variant with slight rule differences.
